versions.content: {DRAFT} Service Name EthIf_MacSecDeleteRxSa (DRAFT) Syntax Std_ReturnType EthIf_MacSecDeleteRxSa ( uint8 CtrlIdx, uint8 An ) Service ID [hex] 0x81 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different CtrlIdx, Non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx CtrlIdx Index of the Ethernet controller within the context of the Ethernet Interface Parameters (in) An Association Number to use in the MACsec's reception secure association Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request has not been accepted Description Request the Ethernet Inferface (MACsec per SW) or the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to remove the Reception Secure Association identified by the provided Association Number. Tags: atp.Status=DRAFT Available via EthIf.h
